entities.name: Query RlmN-like enzyme
observations: 393 aa protein with 87.6% identity and 98.5% coverage to reviewed Paracoccus denitrificans RlmN A1B4Z8.
Pfam detects RlmN_N at residues 25–88 and Radical_SAM at residues 132–309.
Sequence-based identification is strongly supported by curated homologs, but exact substrate activity remains an inference from homology.

entities.name: RlmN
observations: Catalyzes C2 methylation of adenine 2503 in 23S rRNA and adenine 37 in tRNA.
Reviewed homologs bind one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and an exchangeable SAM.
Reference active-site features include a proton acceptor near position 115 and an S-methylcysteine intermediate near position 368.

entities.name: RlmN rRNA methylation
observations: Adenosine(2503) in 23S rRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine(2503) using two SAM molecules, producing 5'-deoxyadenosine, methionine, S-adenosylhomocysteine, and oxidized electron-transfer cofactors in the mapped Rhea representation.
Mapped to RHEA:42916 and related Rhea records.

entities.name: RlmN tRNA methylation
observations: Adenosine(37) in tRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine(37) using two SAM molecules, producing 5'-deoxyadenosine, methionine, S-adenosylhomocysteine, and oxidized electron-transfer cofactors in the mapped Rhea representation.
Mapped to RHEA:43332 and related Rhea records.

entities.name: RlmN [4Fe-4S] cofactor
observations: RlmN homologs bind one [4Fe-4S] cluster; the cluster supports radical-SAM chemistry and is coordinated by three cysteines plus an exchangeable SAM ligand.
